You see a fridge. There's something about an object in a room that's just so... TextWorld. The fridge is empty! What a waste of a day! You can make out a closed oven. You can make out a table. You see a cookbook on the table. Hmmm... what else, what else? As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a counter. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. You scan the room for a stove, and you find a stove. I guess it's true what they say, if you're looking for a stove, go to TextWorld. The stove is conventional. On the stove you can make out a sliced white onion, a sliced raw purple potato, a sliced raw red potato, a sliced banana, a sliced red onion, a sliced orange bell pepper, a sliced yellow bell pepper and a sliced raw yellow potato.
